evidence.summary: The generated answer-detail page has the right search input, answer panel, confidence badge, and save/share actions. However, the source cards are visually quiet, citation markers are hard to connect to the source list, and the source detail panel does not clearly show active selection.

strengths: The generated result keeps the research workspace direction.
The answer panel, confidence badge, and save/share controls are present.

findings.brief_reference: quality_bar.review_criteria: answer and sources have clear hierarchy
findings.issue: Source cards are too low-contrast compared with the answer body.
findings.evidence: The pasted summary says source cards are visually quiet and hard to notice.
findings.recommended_change: Increase source card hierarchy with clearer title weight, excerpt contrast, active source state, and visible source count.

findings.brief_reference: structure.interaction_contract: Citation markers in the answer scroll or focus the matching source card.
findings.issue: Citation markers do not clearly connect to source cards.
findings.evidence: The pasted summary says citation markers are hard to connect to the source list.
findings.recommended_change: Make citation markers and matching source cards share an active state and visible focus treatment.

findings.brief_reference: DESIGN.md Components: source cards should reveal title, excerpt, date, owner or system, and link status.
findings.issue: The selected source detail panel does not clearly show active selection.
findings.evidence: The pasted summary says the source detail panel lacks clear active selection.
findings.recommended_change: Add selected-source label, active card highlight, and source metadata in the detail panel.

visual_review.notes: No inspectable screenshot was available in this run, so the review used the pasted summary and saved brief package as fallback evidence.

keep: Keep the Dense Research Workspace strategy.
Keep the top search area, answer panel, confidence badge, and save/share controls.
Keep the restrained BriefSearch Workspace visual system from DESIGN.md.
change: Make source cards more visible without overpowering the answer body.
Add a clear active state linking citation markers, source cards, and source detail.
Show source title, excerpt, date, owner or system, link status, and relevance more clearly.
Improve source detail selection feedback on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
do_not_change: Do not switch to a marketing-first composition.
Do not replace the dense research workspace with a generic dashboard.
Do not remove answer confidence, save/share feedback, or required answer states.
acceptance_checks: The first screen still shows query, answer confidence, answer body, and source origin.
Citation markers visibly connect to matching source cards.
The selected source detail panel has an obvious active state.
All changes continue to follow DESIGN.md colors, spacing, radius, and source-card rules.
